content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a Null Pointer Exception (NPE) that occurred during the Ambari schema upgrade process when attempting to update Hive configurations. Specifically, the code was trying to access properties of the `hsiSiteConfig` object without first checking if `hsiSiteConfig` was null. This oversight led to a situation where the code would throw an NPE if `hsiSiteConfig` was not properly initialized or fetched, impacting the upgrade process. The patch added a null-check for the `hsiSiteConfig` before proceeding to access its properties, preventing the NPE.
